create_EMA_wrapper: create an EMA wrapper around a PyTorch model with a configurable decay rate for exponential moving average tracking
update_EMA_shadow_params: update the EMA shadow parameters by calling update_ema after each training step to maintain exponential moving averages
copy_EMA_to_model: copy the EMA shadow parameters back to the original model using copy_to_model for evaluation with smoothed weights
backup_and_restore_model_params: backup current model parameters before switching to eval mode and restore them when returning to train mode
toggle_EMA_train_eval_mode: toggle between train and eval mode to automatically swap between original and EMA shadow parameters
